x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      HIL or stemmed "case study" or stemmed "hardware-in-the-loop"
      or stemmed "market participation" or stemmed "real-world data"
      or demonstration or experiment or field or pilot
    )
    and (
      V1G or V2B or V2G or V2H or stemmed "EV fleet"
      or stemmed "electric vehicle" or stemmed "smart charging"
      or stemmed "vehicle-to-building" or stemmed "vehicle-to-grid"
      or stemmed "vehicle-to-home"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "backup power"
      or stemmed "critical load"
      or stemmed "emergency operation"
      or islanding
      or outage
      or resilience
    )
  )
